summary: Executed backend and frontend validation for required MVP flows using public URL. POST /api/leads and critical UI journeys passed, including hero visibility, desktop/mobile navigation, FAQ accordion behavior, and both lead form submissions.
action_items: No blocking issues found in tested scope.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS is configured with allow_credentials=True and wildcard default '*' origin fallback. Tighten CORS_ORIGINS in deployed environments for security hardening.
test_credentials: No auth flow tested. /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but has no credentials entries.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_* style lead payloads via POST /api/leads during API and UI submission tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression coverage now includes /api/leads positive + validation tests in /app/backend/tests/test_leads_api.py. UI checks validated all requested routes and submissions via data-testid selectors on public URL.
rca of the issue: No functional defects reproduced in requested scope. One initial mobile Playwright click failed with 'outside viewport' during menu overlay animation; immediate retest confirmed app behavior is correct and issue was automation timing-related, not a product defect.
